items.title: Mega Desert Village
items.creator: Gearblocks
items.description: Explore this sunny town in the middle of a giant oasis! Lots of houses to live, loot and find. Maybe you can tame some cute lhamas around there?

items.title: Townhouse Parkour
items.creator: Giggle Block Studios
items.description:
Are you ready for some awesome eclectic and cool parkour? These jumps are fun and designed for multiple skill levels! 
* Lots of gameplay!
* Fun for everyone!
* Power-ups and much more!
* Modern townhouse with classic parkour!

items.title: Secret Bed Base
items.creator: KA Studios
items.description:
Under the bed is a Super Secret Base! But don't tell anyone! Explore the base and enjoy discovering new rooms and areas!

+ Secret Base
+ Multiple rooms
+ Fun Activities
+ And much more!

+By Khubeb786

items.title: The Farm
items.creator: Blu Shutter Bug
items.description:
The farm is where you wanna be! Just imagine, living on the beautiful countryside! A couple of cute farm animals and really just enjoying the farm life. To me that sounds like a vacation! Come on by and try it out!

- 21 skins
- By: Blu Shutter Bug

items.title: Creepy Crawlies
items.creator: Blu Shutter Bug
items.description:
Creepy crawlies.... come out and play! These creatures have crawled out from the cavernous depths. They are hungry, they are weird, and they are creepy! Talking about it makes my skin crawl! Enjoy these insect inspired skins!

- 10 skins
- By: Blu Shutter Bug

items.title: City Life
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
Explore and roleplay with this massive city in CITY LIFE!

+ 1.20!
+ HIGH quality city with INTERIORS
+ CARS!
+ FURNITURE!

items.title: Furniture: Dogs
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
Furniture: Dogs is a cute world filled with doggy costumes and many variants of dog-themed furniture! 

- 8 furniture variants 
- Unlock 10 dog costumes

items.title: SUPER TOOLS!
items.creator: Chunklabs
items.description:
You want the most overpowered tools Minecraft can bring? Kill instantly? Mine blocks ultra fast? Be undefeatable? Then these are the tools you need! Gather wools super fast, make your friends look like fools with these amazing gadgets.
+ Mine super ores and craft super tools and overpowered gear!
+ Cool base with a pool that cools you off
+ Play alone or with friends

items.title: Delta Gardens
items.creator: BTWN Creations
items.description:
Take a trip to the beautiful Delta Gardens where flower beds and crop greenhouses provide a center piece for a natural landscape with forest paths, animal barns, and a village to explore.

-By BTWN

items.title: Atlantis City
items.creator: ThunderAy
items.description:
Explore the lost atlantis city and start an unforgettable adventure!
Everyone has been searching for it and you've been the one to find it first!

+ A big, mysterious city, in the middle of the ocean! 
+ Discover many great places and take control over the atlantis!

items.title: Modern Teens
items.creator: ThunderAy
items.description:
These skins have the newest modern clothes for you to go out in the city and have fun!

+ 12 exclusive skins!
+ Several teenagers with modern style!

items.title: Dogs
items.creator: ThunderAy
items.description:
Look at these cute and beautiful dogs... I think they want an owner to have fun with!

- 12 cute skins.
- All very friendly!

items.title: Elemental Slimes
items.creator: 57Digital
items.description:
You're as cold as ice, as hot as the sun. As green as grass, as white as snow. You're also a... slime? Become different elements and wonderful slimes with the Elemental Slime skin pack, where you can blend in with the swamp and the elements both!

- 10 slimy skins
- By 57Digital

items.title: Anime Streamers
items.creator: 57Digital
items.description:
Have you always wanted to be a streamer? Ever wanted to be in your favorite anime? Why not both! Take the best of both worlds and become an Anime Streamer today! What better time to start gathering followers than while you're in the mine collecting diamonds?

- 6 smiling skins
- By 57Digital

items.title: Hackers
items.creator: 57Digital
items.description:
Hack your way into the mines and claim all the diamonds you can before others get to them! Make sure to stay anonymous with the Hackers skin pack, or who knows who will find you out...

- 10 skins
- *hacker voice* I'm in.
- By 57Digital

items.title: Titan Mobs
items.creator: House of How
items.description: This skin features 14 mobs re-emerging and shaped from the terrain of the earth. Ancient and powerful. Join the mightiest here!

items.title: Fintropolis
items.creator: Blockworks
items.description:
Explore Fintropolis, created by BlockWorks in collaboration with Ally. Take your money game to the next level with life-boosting financial building blocks. Discover how a few concepts like saving, investing, and budgeting can help you thrive in and out of the game.

- Huge city to explore
- Upgrade your house
- Choose your job
- Earn money, save and invest

items.title: Gang of Misfits
items.creator: inPixel
items.description:
Ever dreamt about the most out of place, crazy and whacky ideas for skins? Dream no more! With the gang of misfits you are sure to be the weirdest one but in a good way! These colorful, yet quirky skins will put you high on the fashion list of every server!

- 10 skins
- By inPixel

items.title: Free The Estate 2
items.creator: Glowfischdesigns
items.description:
The Pillager horde has done it again! These poor villages want their land back, can you give them a hand?
Free the estate from the Pillager horde! Reclaim the island, change it to your hearts content, mine for ores, and show off to your friends!

+ A beautiful detailed survival world.
+ Tons of treasures for you to find.
+ Great map for roleplay.

items.title: Peaceful Slimes
items.creator: Netherpixel
items.description:
These slimes are not dangerous, they live in peace. Put them on and discover what it is to be a true peaceful slime!

- Twelve peaceful slimes.
- Two skins totally free.
- By DragonClub Studios.

items.title: Trendy Anime 2021
items.creator: Glorious Studios
items.description:
It's sunny and hot, it is finally summer! It is the time to wear trendy clothes! Put on these trendy outfits and have a crazy summer with your friends! You are sure to go unnoticed with these trendy outfits!

Also perfect for PvP, PvE and combat!

+ 25 Trendy Anime Skins

items.title: Creeper Ores!
items.creator: Razzleberries
items.description:
These special creepers have got vibrant and unique ores embedded inside of them!
Pick up this Creeper Ores pack and camouflage yourself from your friends or hide from your enemies!

+ 8 HD skins!
+ 1 free HD skin!
+ Includes diamond, gold, and rainbow camo ores!

items.title: Pirates: Journey to a Treasure
items.creator: Pathway Studios
items.description:
Ahoy! The Navy is after us and we have to flee before they catch us! 
The crew needs you, captain! Choose between these eight skins and help your crew get your treasure safely!

With you in charge, the Navy will never catch you!

- 8 unique pirate skins
- By Varuna & Pathway Studios

items.title: Mobs in Summer
items.creator: Pathway Studios
items.description:
Everyone deserves a vacation, even those mobs that make our world better, or in the case of a creeper or two... worse. This summer, they won't be hitting up your town: they'll be hitting up the beaches sporting the latest summer fashions in this trendy skin pack!

- Includes 8 unique skins!
- Options for cows, pigs, zombies and more!
- By SmartPixel & Pathway Studios
